gates.says: all 10 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-vans: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-vans: "Vehicles moving between places? The routing library." The routing variants include "time windows at each stop".
recorded.prompt:q-booth: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-booth: "The order of jobs on one machine or one crew... goes to CP-SAT". Also "tasks with start times and durations that may not overlap".
recorded.prompt:q-nurses: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses: Reference table: "one-to-one pairing at least cost, nothing else | SimpleLinearSumAssignment". Procedure Q2: "Exactly an assignment... with every rule in that solver's inputs?" Nurses to shifts, one each, nothing else, is exactly that. The page never says 'cost table', but the solver takes "arcs with costs", so the reason fits.
recorded.prompt:q-nurses-cap: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses-cap: "a rule that couples pairs cannot" be said. "it is a row of the model, and only a general model has rows". Integer, no logic: "Otherwise: MathOpt".
recorded.prompt:q-blend: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-blend: "A continuous variable... CP-SAT has no continuous variable, and handed one... it rounds it". "Rules of logic do not change this".
recorded.prompt:q-prices: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-prices: Reference: "shadow prices or reduced costs | MathOpt with GLOP or HiGHS, as an LP | only LP solvers return duals".
recorded.prompt:q-lab: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-lab: Reference: "one or more capacity rows over yes/no items, nothing else | KnapsackSolver". "more capacity rows can" be said.
recorded.prompt:q-grain: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-grain: "a problem that decides only how much moves along each road... is a flow... even when trucks carry the loads". Reference: supplies, demands, capacitated arcs.
recorded.prompt:q-trimming: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-trimming: An integer-only general model goes to **CP-SAT** when it is mostly logic: tasks with start times and durations that may not overlap, crews shared over time, "this job before that one, or the other way round", many if-then rules.
recorded.prompt:q-legacy: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-legacy: New code goes to MathOpt; a `pywraplp` model you inherit is read, tested and migrated (lessons 4.7.1 and 4.7.2).

recorded.prompt:q-vans:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-vans:a: "The first that says yes decides". Question 1 (vehicles) comes before CP-SAT's question 4.
recorded.prompt:q-vans:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-vans:b: The routing passage says to "accept" good routes over proofs. Question 1 sends this problem to routing.
recorded.prompt:q-vans:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-vans:d: A flow is a problem "with no vehicle's sequence of stops in it". This problem has van routes, so it is not a flow.
recorded.prompt:q-booth:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-booth:b: "Do not stretch 'routing' to everything with an order in it". Jobs on one machine go to CP-SAT.
recorded.prompt:q-booth:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-booth:c: Job order on one machine goes to CP-SAT (routing section). Reference table: start times, durations, no-overlap go to CP-SAT.
recorded.prompt:q-booth:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-booth:d: Question 4, "Intervals, sequencing... all integer? CP-SAT". Nothing here is fractional.
recorded.prompt:q-nurses:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses:a: "The first that says yes decides". Question 2 (assignment) comes before question 4 (CP-SAT), and CP-SAT is for "intervals, sequencing or dense logic", which this problem does not have.
recorded.prompt:q-nurses:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses:b: Routing is for "Vehicles moving between places?" and "Do not stretch 'routing' to everything with an order in it". No vehicles or stops here.
recorded.prompt:q-nurses:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses:c: KnapsackSolver is for "one or more capacity rows over yes/no items, nothing else". This problem is a one-to-one pairing with no capacity rows, which the page sends to the assignment solver.
recorded.prompt:q-nurses-cap:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses-cap:a: "For the assignment solver, a rule about one pair can... a rule that couples pairs cannot."
recorded.prompt:q-nurses-cap:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses-cap:c: Question 1 applies only to vehicles moving between places. No vehicles here.
recorded.prompt:q-nurses-cap:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-nurses-cap:d: Knapsack takes "capacity rows over yes/no items, nothing else". The one-each pairing rules are not capacity rows.
recorded.prompt:q-blend:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-blend:a: "Rules of logic do not change this: MathOpt states 'if this, then that' with indicator constraints or big-M rows".
recorded.prompt:q-blend:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-blend:c: Knapsack solvers "take whole numbers only". The page sends fractional quantities to MathOpt with HiGHS or SCIP.
recorded.prompt:q-blend:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-blend:d: "New code goes to MathOpt". The wrapper's LP solvers also "drop integer variables silently", which would lose the yes/no decision.
recorded.prompt:q-prices:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.prompt:q-prices:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-prices:b: "among MathOpt's solvers only GLOP, PDLP and HiGHS return them". SCIP is not among them.
recorded.prompt:q-prices:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-prices:d: "Dual values... Only an LP has them". Question 3 sends dual prices to MathOpt.
recorded.prompt:q-lab:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lab:b: An assignment is a "one-to-one pairing". Experiments are picked, not paired.
recorded.prompt:q-lab:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lab:c: No vehicles move between places, so question 1 does not apply.
recorded.prompt:q-lab:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lab:d: Question 2 decides first (knapsack). The data is whole-number, so nothing fractional sends it to question 3.
recorded.prompt:q-grain:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grain:a: "The first that says yes decides". Question 2 (exactly a flow) comes before CP-SAT.
recorded.prompt:q-grain:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grain:b: Same passage: with no vehicle's sequence of stops, it is a flow "even when trucks carry the loads".
recorded.prompt:q-grain:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grain:c: "For a flow solver, capacities, costs, supplies and demands can" be said. The problem is a min-cost flow, not a knapsack.
recorded.prompt:q-trimming:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-trimming:a: Lesson 4.4.4, later in this section, measures why: a sequencing model written for HiGHS with big-M disjunctions kept a bound of 0 after 10,000 nodes on 10 circuits, while CP-SAT proved every optimum in its limit.
recorded.prompt:q-trimming:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-trimming:b: New code goes to MathOpt; a `pywraplp` model you inherit is read, tested and migrated (lessons 4.7.1 and 4.7.2).
recorded.prompt:q-trimming:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-trimming:d: the routing library searches, and reports `ROUTING_SUCCESS` for a good route, not a proof of the best one.
recorded.prompt:q-legacy:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-legacy:a: the solver is fixed when the model is created, and its LP solvers drop integer variables silently (lesson 4.1.2).
recorded.prompt:q-legacy:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-legacy:c: Migrated means moved to MathOpt, where the procedure starts every general model, not ported to a special solver or another API.
recorded.prompt:q-legacy:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-legacy:d: It is a capital budget that is not a knapsack: its must-do projects, alternatives and parent links are the rules the knapsack solver cannot take
